data.name: SiteIntro
data.value: Where the installation is, its time zone, and the home battery the forecast modes plan around. Gleanvolt starts without the location and the time zone, but asks for them: without the location there is no weather, and without the time zone a Windows host counts its days in UTC; without the home battery, Forecasted charges from live surplus only.

data.name: InverterIntro
data.value: Gleanvolt talks to the inverter over Modbus TCP. Search the network for it, or type its address, then save: saving reads one value from it, to check it is the device you meant.

data.name: ChargerPlugin
data.value: Gleanvolt controls the EV charger through a plugin: a small program for your charger's brand, with its own page where you enter the charger's address. Start the plugin: it asks to connect, and you accept it here or later on Settings → External providers. Gleanvolt uses the charger as soon as the plugin connects. Until then, no charging mode can be started.

data.name: ChargerToken
data.value: The provider token every plugin connects with:

data.name: ChargerNoToken
data.value: Plugins connect with a provider token. There is none yet.

data.name: ChargerLater
data.value: You can add the charger now or any time later; you don't need to come back here.
